messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: streaming-decode p99 (us-west-2) exceeded 1200ms for 5m. autoscale/rollout=trt8-flashattn-v0.3.1, compilepath=opt-flag-set-A

sara-oncall: ack. i'm on call. starting triage now. any recent deploys in the last 30m?

mike-runtime: yep, rolled trt8-flashattn-v0.3.1 kernel at 5523452500 across us-west-2 pool. rolling compflag A->B as part of the build.

alisha-sre: confirming p95/p99 spikes from infra metrics: p95 went 220ms->480ms, p99 410ms->1350ms for streaming endpoints. tail-queue depth bumped, KV eviction increased. customer-facing error rate unchanged but latency-sensitive customers seeing timeouts on streaming windows > 10s.

sara-oncall: @mike-runtime can you attach the deploy id and the buildkite link? also paste any failing logs.

mike-runtime: build: https://ci.redwood/teams/runtime/builds/2389, job: trt-kernel-prod, deploy-id=deploy-2026-07-15-2389. logs: `WARN decode: fallback to kernel-legacy for batch_size>8` appears intermittently. stack traces show long waits in `kv_cache::evict()` and `decode::dispatch_kernel`.

--- paste log snippet ---
```
2026-07-15T18:09:03Z WARN decode: kernel dispatch latency 1123ms for shard=usw2-gpu-27
2026-07-15T18:09:03Z INFO kv_cache: eviction took 920ms (items=2048)
2026-07-15T18:09:04Z ERROR streaming: stall detected, inflight=64, backlog=12
```
--- end snippet ---

alisha-sre: correlated with a bump in page-faults on kernel module after compile flag B. looks like a paging/regression in the new compile path.

sara-oncall: mitigation plan options: 1) rollback kernel to previous trt8-flashattn-v0.3.0 2) toggle compile flag to legacy path 3) route traffic to compat model variant (lower perf but stable). prefer quick rollback + routing fallback as dual safety.

mike-runtime: i can trigger a rollback. preparing rollback command now.

mike-runtime: executing:
```
redwood-deploy rollback --cluster=us-west-2 --deploy-id=deploy-2026-07-15-2389 --to-version=trt8-flashattn-v0.3.0
```

-- issuing rollback, will watch p99.

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated for deploy-2026-07-15-2389 by mike-runtime. Rollback job id=rb-5523456795. Estimated completion ~ 2m.

alisha-sre: spinning up routing fallback: updating route policy for streaming endpoint to prefer model variant `gpt-stream-compat-v1` for 20% of traffic as canary, will bump if stable.

jordan-support: notifying top 3 affected customers (acct: hyperchat, convoai, eduassist). sending heads-up: "we're investigating elevated latency in us-west-2 streaming, mitigation in progress; you may see transient reconnects".

sara-oncall: monitoring dashboards. ping me when rollback completes or if deploy-bot reports any failures. also set `USE_FLASHATTN=false` on a few canary nodes as a short-lived mitigation if rollback stalls.

-- 90s later --

deploy-bot: Rollback job rb-5523456795 completed successfully across 95% of nodes; remaining nodes draining.

alisha-sre: initial post-rollback metrics: p95 -> 230ms (from 480ms), p99 -> 430ms (from 1350ms). streaming stalls reduced, backlog down to ~2.

sara-oncall: good. keep routing fallback at 10% for now. mike, please open a detailed incident ticket and run `perf/regress` suite against trt8-flashattn-v0.3.1 with compile-flag B. we need targeted reproducer for paging.

mike-runtime: will run perf harness and binary diffs. first glance shows extra page touches in the kernel when seq_len>1024 and batch_size>16, likely due to changed memory layout in the new compile path.

ryan-product: any customer-visible SLA breaches to report? p99 was >1.2s for about 6 minutes. SLA window for streaming says p99 < 500ms monthly. need to know if this crosses alerting threshold for account owners.

jordan-support: we logged support tickets from 3 customers, no active incident escalations yet. they were notified proactively.

sara-oncall: note for handoff: incident severity = S2 (customer impact limited, mitigated by rollback). postmortem owner: @mike-runtime. next steps: reproduce, fix compile flag/regression, add regression alert for compile-flag changes, add canary perf test covering seq_len>1024/batch>16, schedule kernel rebuild with different linker flags.

alisha-sre: I'll keep the monitoring guardrails tighter and add a short-lived anomaly alert for kernel compile-path changes to trigger earlier.

sara-oncall: handing off to @alex-oncall for next shift at 5523460000. checklist: incident ticket created (INC-2026-0892), rollback done, customers notified, perf job kicked off, infra flagged for follow-up. update the incident doc with timelines and attach logs.

alex-oncall: acked. will take it from here, will coordinate next-sprint fix with runtime and QA.

mike-runtime: adding reproduction steps and initial bisect in the incident doc. linking PRs once triage complete. thanks all for quick response. :thumbsup:
